message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown; white gives a cleaner flavor |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed or natural; choose based on your taste preference |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (5 g) | Works with acidic ingredients (like buttermilk) |
| Baking powder | 1 tsp (5 g) | Adds lift if you’re not using buttermilk |
| Salt | ½ tsp (2.5 g) | Enhances flavor |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature for better emulsion |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with buttermilk or almond milk |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer flavor |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 ml) | Pure vanilla for best aroma |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist crumb |
| Optional: strong brewed coffee | 1 tsp (5 ml) | Intensifies chocolate flavor |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- ¼ cup (60 ml) heavy cream or sour cream (replaces part of the milk)
- ½ cup (120 ml) melted dark chocolate (adds depth)
- 1 cup (120 g) chopped nuts or chocolate chips (for texture)

Feel free to adjust quantities or swap out ingredients to suit dietary needs or flavor preferences. Happy baking!
